liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Groundspeed**: earliest performance in the archive; rare: 7 archived performances [15]
- **Sorrow is a Highway**: rare: 12 archived performances [15]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Whisper My Name [15]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2020-01-17.Aud.Matrix.Flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 25 songs; 161 min [1]
- **billystrings2020-01-17.aud.c480b.ck63.mkh8040.nico11104.flac24**: audience recording; 25 songs; 160 min [2]
- **billystrings2020-01-17.litz.schoepsMK4v.flac24**: source not stated; 25 songs; 161 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **billystrings2020-01-17.litzenberger.akg414.neumannKM150.schoepsMK41v.schoepsMK4v.flac16**: source not stated; 25 songs; 160 min [4]

## Around the show

- Tony Trischka joined on banjo for this Friday night show [1]
- Tony Trischka sat in on banjo [3]
- Tony Trischka guested on banjo [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2020-01-17.Aud.Matrix.Flac16**: taped by Jeff Fieldtaper Fuchs; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: Superlux s502 ORTF Mics + Seinheisser m80 Mics > TASCAM 70D [1]. Also: Mics were placed beside the soundboard in the tapers section, twelve feet up [1]
- **billystrings2020-01-17.aud.c480b.ck63.mkh8040.nico11104.flac24**: taped by Fred Nicolois; transferred by Fred Nicolois; source: Aud>C483.MKH8040>F6 [2]. Also: Recorded with Sennheiser MKH8040 and AKG C480B mics with C63ULS capsules into a Zoom F6, 32-bit float at 48kHz, converted to FLAC [2]
- **billystrings2020-01-17.litz.schoepsMK4v.flac24**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK4v's>KCY 250/5i>VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II [3]
- **billystrings2020-01-17.litzenberger.akg414.neumannKM150.schoepsMK41v.schoepsMK4v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: AKG 414 XLS'(Hypercardioid) + Neumann KM150's + Schoeps MK41v's>KCY 250/5i>VST62iu + Schoeps MK4v's>KCY 250/5i>VST62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II (@32 BIT… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Billy Strings - 2020-01-17 The Capitol Theatre, Port Chester, NY](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2020/10/billy-strings-2020-01-17-capitol.html) [16]
- Fan art by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings The Capitol Theatre - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/venue/the-capitol-theatre/) [17]
- Poster by Jake May: [Billy Strings Schedules FANS.com Broadcast of January Capitol Theatre Show](https://jambands.com/news/2020/05/27/billy-strings-schedules-fans-com-broadcast-of-january-capitol-theatre-show/) [18]

Two sets of mics, Superlux s502 ORTF and Sennheiser m80, into Tascam 70D recorders, combined in Audacity; processed by Rich Stoler

Tony Trischka sat in on banjo

Litzenberger mixed AKG 414, Neumann KM150, and Schoeps MK41v and MK4v mics from a MixPre-10 II in Nuendo, then converted to 16-bit/44.1kHz
